Extract nighttime lights for many periods

Source: R/extract.R
ntl_extract.Rd

The workhorse of the package: for every series and period in a manifest it reads the files (ntl_read()), applies masking rules (ntl_mask()) and computes zonal statistics with coverage diagnostics (ntl_aggregate()). Periods are processed one at a time, so memory use does not grow with the length of the series.

Usage

ntl_extract(
  manifest,
  units,
  id_col = NULL,
  quality_max = 1,
  min_obs = NULL,
  flares = NULL,
  cap = NULL,
  variable = NULL,
  flip = NA,
  quiet = FALSE
)

Arguments

manifest

A manifest from ntl_fetch() or ntl_files(). Several manifests can be combined with rbind().

units

Polygons: sf or SpatVector.

id_col

Column of units with unique identifiers. If NULL, row numbers are used and the output column is called unit_id.

quality_max

Keep pixels with quality <= quality_max. NULL disables the rule. Ignored if there is no quality layer.

min_obs

Keep pixels with at least this many cloud-free observations. NULL disables the rule. Ignored if there is no nobs layer.

flares

Optional gas-flare mask: an sf/SpatVector of polygons or a SpatRaster whose non-zero cells are flares. Pixels touching a flare polygon are removed.

cap

Optional upper bound; values above it are set to cap (top-coding of extreme outliers, applied after masking).

variable

Value layer. Defaults to the product's value_layer (NearNadir_Composite_Snow_Free). Count and quality layers are <variable>_Num and <variable>_Quality.

flip

NA (automatic), TRUE or FALSE.

quiet

Suppress progress messages.

Value

An ntl_long data frame: one row per unit, series and period, with the columns described in ntl_aggregate() plus series, product, platform, period and period_label.

Details

Pixels belonging to tiles missing from the archive are treated as unobserved, so they lower share_valid instead of silently changing the area being summed.

Examples

ex <- ntl_example()
m <- ntl_files(ex$dir, "eog_vnl_monthly")
m <- m[m$period <= as.Date("2021-06-01"), ] # keep the example fast
long <- ntl_extract(m, ex$units_old, id_col = "district", min_obs = 1)
